description: This PHP source file defines a class smpl_Quote_Group_Sample that generates a PDF quote template with dynamic content, including header, body, and footer sections, for the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: smpl_Quote_Group_Sample
classes.description: A class that provides methods to generate a quote PDF template with dynamic content, including header, body, and footer sections.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of document, which is 'AOS_Quotes'.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the body of the quote PDF, including company info, quote details, and line items.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns the header content for the PDF, currently empty.

methods.name: getFooter
methods.description: Generates and returns the footer HTML for the PDF, including page number and date.
